elevenlabsPrompt:
[intrigued] Can't stop scrolling? One hidden setting makes your phone boring.

[confident] Here's the fix. Turn your screen gray.

[friendly] Open Settings, then Accessibility. Tap Display and Text Size. Turn on Color Filters and pick Grayscale. Set it as your triple-click shortcut.

[delighted] Same phone, just a lot less tempting.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
